raw_segments.text: Queen Elizabeth, cousins indeed, and by their uncle-cousined of comfort, kingdom, kindred,
freedom, life, whose hand soever lanced their tender hearts, thy head, all indirectly, gave
direction. No doubt the murderous knife was dull and blunt till it was wetted on thy stone-hard
heart to revel in the entrails of my lambs. But that still use of grief makes wild grief
tame. My tongue should to thy ears not name my boys till that my nails were anchored in
thine eyes. And I, in such a disparate bay of death, like a poor bark of sails and tackling
raft, rush all to pieces on thy rocky bosom.
